placements.why: The envelope is entirely about maintaining rollback capability through rehearsed practice — the principle that rehearsal constitutes capability, the directive setting a monthly cadence, and the structured record ratifying cadence and ownership. No existing strata category covers operational readiness or rehearsed-capability themes; this content calls for one.
placements.title: operational resilience through rehearsed capability
placements.frame: What practices, principles, and organizational mechanisms sustain the readiness of operational capabilities under this repo's authority?

placements.title: unrehearsed capability is no capability at all
placements.frame: Does the expression frame rehearsal or practice as the constitutive condition for claiming a capability — equating what hasn't been exercised with what doesn't exist?
placements.why: src-2 states the constitutive principle — an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all — as definitional bedrock. src-1 enacts that principle as a settled monthly cadence mandate. Together they form a thematic statement true beyond these specific words: rehearsal as the condition for capability is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding whenever operational readiness is grounded in practice.

placements.title: directive authority performed through structured record
placements.frame: How does a settled directive's authority get performed through structured field attribution — cadence fixed, owner named — in the organizational record?
placements.why: src-3 and src-4 are documented field entries — Cadence and Owner — that ratify the directive's schedule and accountability as settled operational facts. The theme of authority performed through structured record-keeping is a subject future envelopes will feed whenever a directive is formalized into organizational documentation.
